* **Experience:** Minimum of 5+ years in operations or project management, ideally within the construction or stone fabrication industry.

Precision Stone Group is a growing St. Louis-based group of companies specializing in premium surface solutions, fabrication coordination, and project management for residential and commercial spaces.

We are seeking a skilled and dependable Maintenance Technician to support the ongoing maintenance and repair of condominium and HOA communities. This role is responsible for routine maintenance, preventative inspections, and project-based repairs across common areas, residential buildings, and exterior property features.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in carpentry, exterior repairs, and general building systems, and takes pride in maintaining safe, high-quality, and visually appealing communities.

***The pay rate for this role starts at $32/hour and up depending on experience + a $3,000 retention bonus***

* ***$500 after completion of the 90-day probationary period***
* ***$1,000 after the 6-month review***
* ***$1,500 after successfully completing one year of employment***

Key Responsibilities

* Perform general maintenance and repair across HOA and condominium properties, including:
* + Wood replacement (siding, trim, railings, fencing)
  + Deck and balcony repair
  + Painting, caulking, sealing, and exterior touch-ups
  + Light carpentry, plumbing, and electrical work
* Conduct routine inspections of buildings, common areas, and amenities to identify maintenance needs and safety concerns
* Complete and track work orders, service requests, and maintenance logs accurately and on time
* Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and HOA standards
* Support seasonal and preventative maintenance, including:
* + Pressure washing
  + Gutter cleaning
  + Snow and ice removal
  + Landscaping assistance
* Maintain and organize tools, equipment, and materials in safe working condition

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; trade school or technical training preferred
* 2+ years of experience in property maintenance, facilities maintenance, or building maintenance
* Strong skills in:
* + Carpentry and wood repair
  + Deck and balcony repair
  + Exterior building maintenance
* Working knowledge of basic plumbing, electrical systems, and building systems
* Ability to read and interpret work orders, blueprints, and maintenance instructions
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Professional communication skills when working with property managers, HOA boards, and residents
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required
* Ownership of basic hand tools preferred

Physical Requirements

* Ability to lift and carry 50+ lbs
* Frequent standing, walking, bending, and climbing ladders
* Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions
* Ability to work at heights (roofs, decks, ladders, scaffolding)

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in HOA, condominium, or multi-family property maintenance
* Familiarity with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems)
* OSHA certification or safety training
* Specialized experience in:
* + Exterior building envelope repair
  + Waterproofing
  + Advanced carpentry

Employment Details

* Full-time, field-based role across multiple communities
* Reports to: Maintenance Director / Maintenance Operations Manager

**HR Strategy & Operations Manager - TA Transformation**  
  
Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/03/2026.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As a HR Strategy & Operations Manager with a focus on Talent Acquisition Transformation, you will serve as a key delivery leader across client engagements spanning talent acquisition strategy, operating model design, service delivery transformation, process improvement, and technology enablement. You will bring deep subject matter expertise in talent acquisition, a client-centric mindset, and the ability to drive complex transformation programs across industries. In this role, you will:  

* Develop talent acquisition strategies aligned to enterprise workforce priorities, including business cases, investment rationale, and ROI models for transformation initiatives
* Advise clients on TA service delivery models, including recruiting operating model design, governance, organizational design, and the effective use of RPO and hybrid delivery approaches
* Lead process and experience design across the end-to-end hiring lifecycle, from requisition planning through onboarding, with a focus on efficiency, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes
* Advising on talent acquisition technology strategy, including market trends, vendor evaluation, selection, design, and implementation

* Lead project delivery activities by managing workplans, tracking progress, identifying and mitigating risks, escalating issues, and ensuring high-quality, on-time deliverables
* Partner with cross-functional teams to develop multi-year Digital HR and TA technology strategies that improve HR and recruiting performance, service delivery, and workforce experience
* Contributing to thought leadership and mentoring junior team members through coaching, feedback, and capability development

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree
* 6+ years of experience in talent acquisition, HR consulting, or talent acquisition advisory, with specialization in talent acquisition transformation
* 1+ year experience working in a consulting environment
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
**Preferred:**  

* Experience with AI-powered talent acquisition tools and leading ATS/CRM platforms, including their practical application
* Minimum of 6 months of experience leading project workstreams, including planning, coordinating team activities, managing deliverables, and ensuring timely achievement of project milestones
* 2+ years of experience interfacing directly with senior executives and clients
* Experience participating in at least one RFP or RFI process, including scoring and evaluating HR products and services
